profile.headline: SWE @ Bloomberg | WG21 (ISO C++) | LLVM Contributor | EECS @ UC Berkeley
profile.summary: I am interested in working on low-latency and concurrency C++. During my free time, I make contributions to open source projects such as LLVM. I have implemented std::views::concat in LLVM libc++, and currently upstreaming reflection into clang.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Trading and Analytics.

- Work on a low-latency shared memory system which empowers fast static and dynamic financial data retrieval.

Skills: C/C++, Linux, Multithreading.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Data Infrastructure  

• Used Terraform to provision resources on Snowflake, AWS and DataDog to automate the process of resource creation, saving time for the team instead of manually creating the resources. 
• Built an integration to grab metrics from Airflow and Snowflake to Datadog.
• Researched for the standardization of tags so we can collect, aggregate data on Datadog dashboard. 
• Built a Datadog dashboard to help teams within the company view the credits they have used with services such as Snowflake, AWS. Build and test on development, staging and production environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Used React to create components for the frontend based on designs from Figma pages. 
• Implemented new APIs in the backend and write tests. 
• Setup CI Pipeline to run automated testing to help detect bugs before releasing into production.
• Built the infrastructure on Google Cloud. Use Kubernetes for Orchestration, and Docker for Containerization. Released the project into production on time. 
• Used Terraform for Cloud Provisioning

projects.title: File Sharing System
projects.description:
- Built a file sharing system using Go
- Any user can create a file, append to a file, and store a file to the system. 
- Support scalable file to make append to a file
- A user can share a file to any other user in the system
- Ensure confidentiality, integrity, authenticity for all features in the system.
